title: Scale Solo #26 (dragon)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, two thick goddess braids — her own skin itself covered in large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not fabric, not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is the real cellular structure of her own skin, each scale casting its own small shadow on the scales beneath it, nothing lying flat as one smooth sheet. Dense overlapping fields — BLAZING METALLIC SILVER scale formations shifting across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID PALE BLUE scale-edge detail filling every remaining gap with real texture, every scale catching the light with a sharp shifting glint as the angle changes, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels covered in the same scale texture, the shimmer continuing unbroken onto the shoe, extra long stiletto nails with the same iridescent shimmer at each tip.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every individual scale and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
